scope: Finite published response sets and register-derived packages. These sets have different date and author-scope gates; do not sum them into the national three-month denominator.
limits: A full read means all author text was read, with targeted factual and version checks. It does not certify every assertion as true.
Known public sets do not prove absence of unpublished, withheld, late-filed or differently indexed contributions.
Author dates, index publication dates, hearing dates and recipient delivery dates remain separate.
The national denominator, coverage percentage and population error rate remain unestablished.
